lessons.title: Practice Standard For Loops
lessons.description: C++ for loops iterate over ranges. Implement sum_range(int start, int end). The test checks that sum_range(1, 5) equals 15.
learning_objectives: Mesa pickers recount crates before dawn, and use for loops in C.
